def bfsplacements(g, sz, s, allowed=(0,1,2)):
 R=len(g);C=len(g[0]);
 def ok(p):
  r,c=p
  return r>=0 and c>=0 and r+sz<=R and c+sz<=C and all(g[i][j] in allowed for i in range(r,r+sz) for j in range(c,c+sz))
 q=deque([s]);pr={s:None}
 while q:
  p=q.popleft()
  for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
   np=(p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc)
   if np not in pr and ok(np): pr[np]=p;q.append(np)
 return pr,ok
